name: Numéro National (national number)
issuer: the National Register of physical persons
note: Belgium's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: an individual's TIN is the Numéro National, attributed on registration in the National Register of physical persons; eleven digits. Read as given on registration, to residents. No check rule, fee or time is stated in the sheet (it points to the EU's TIN portal for detail, not read).

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Belgium: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: For individuals the TIN corresponds to the "Numéro National (NN)", which is attributed when a registration on the national Register of the physical persons is made. ... For individuals the TIN number of identification consists of eleven digits
